tools.name: search
tools.description: Search official Apple developer documentation and WWDC video transcripts using hybrid retrieval (keyword + semantic), followed by Jev relevance ranking of the merged candidates. Returns ranked source excerpts; use fetch for complete page content. Browse an indexed topic to discover its subtopics.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Browse indexed Apple developer documentation one level at a time, with small branches expanded automatically. Open a documentation URL or start at the root. Resolve each href against its parent, applying base first when present. Browse a section to explore it, or fetch a document to read it.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a public webpage by URL. Open a document from search or browse, or read a URL you already have. The response identifies its source and retrieval method.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
